summary: Newlywed couple Costas John Sivyllis, 30 (United Airlines pilot) and Lindsey Vogelaar, 33 (United flight attendant) crashed their Beechcraft S35 Bonanza (N4444K) in Ingram Basin about 8 miles east of Telluride shortly after departing Telluride Regional Airport (~12:45 p.m.); NTSB (CEN21FA007) records a ~1:04 p.m. near-vertical impact at 11,823 ft; San Miguel County SO search ran 4:30-6:25 p.m.; both killed.
location: Ingram Basin, ~8 mi east of Telluride
responding_agency: San Miguel County Sheriff's Office, San Miguel County SAR
notes: Married in Telluride Oct 1, 2020 (honeymoon); VFR cross-country to Florida. NTSB final cause per later reporting: loss of control during the climb / decision not to climb higher before proceeding over high terrain.
wx_note: ERA5 archive 0.25° grid (Open-Meteo); coord basis: county (San Miguel County, Colorado, United States)
